label: PF Backlog 590
title: dogfood: monitoring - wait/poll + terminal event/webhook + status aggregation
body:
## Problem / why
A 5-30 min run needs poll + push; Phase 1 dogfood_run.status exists but there is no terminal push.

## Goal / value
Expose progress via the shared bus: poll (run_status/events) + subscribe (SSE/webhook) + aggregate status.

## In scope
- dogfood_run.status uses the shared bus; terminal dogfood.finished event; wait respects an env timeout.

## Out of scope
- Building the bus (BI-PF-1265); UI.

## Acceptance criteria
- A client can poll and/or subscribe and learn when a dogfood finishes and act.

## Verification / test plan
- Status/summary test; terminal event emitted on completion.
